en.headline: Police to prosecute dual-plate driver for mounting Causeway Bay pavement
en.dek: A 56-year-old man will face a careless driving charge after video showed his car turning onto the footpath outside Sogo, endangering pedestrians on 20 October.
body: Police are to prosecute a 56-year-old male driver for careless driving after a private car with dual mainland and Hong Kong licence plates was filmed mounting the pavement in Causeway Bay.

The video, which circulated online, showed the car travelling east along Hennessy Road around 2pm on 20 October. Outside Sogo department store, it suddenly turned left onto the pavement at the junction with East Point Road, seriously endangering pedestrians.

The Hong Kong Island traffic investigation team reviewed the footage and identified the vehicle and driver on 23 October. The case has been classified as careless driving and remains under investigation.
Careless driving carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5,000 fine and six months’ imprisonment. Police reminded drivers to pay attention to road signs and plan their journeys in advance.

zh.headline: 兩地牌車銅鑼灣鋳行人路 56歲司機將被控不小心駕駛
zh.dek: 警方經調查後於23日識別司機，指車輛在軒尼詩道近東角道崇光外突然轉入行人路，嚴重危及途人。
body: 警方將檢控一名56歲男司機，涉嫌不小心駕駛。事緣一輛掛有兩地牌的私家車被拍到在銅鑼灣鋳上行人路。
網上流傳的影片顯示，車輛於10月20日下午約2時沿軒尼詩道東行，在崇光百貨外近東角道路口突然左轉駛上行人路，嚴重危及途人安全。
港島總區交通調查隊檢視影片後，於23日識別涉事車輛及司機。案件列作不小心駕駛調查，仍在跟進中。
不小心駕駛最高可處罰款5000元及監禁六個月。警方提醒駕駛人士留意道路標誌，並預先計劃行程。
